def _self_test(server, launch: Launch, url: str, expected_page: str, storage: str, target: Path, out: TextIO, colors: bool=False) -> int:
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    result: dict[str, Any] = {'profile': launch.name, 'standard': launch.standard, 'kind': launch.kind, 'port': server.server_port, 'storage_is_default': storage == str(default_storage_root()), 'console_colors': colors}
    try:
        status, body = _get(url + 'status')
        result['status'] = status
        result['service'] = json.loads(body).get('service')
        page_status, page = _get(url)
        page_text = page.decode('utf-8')
        result['page_status'] = page_status
        result['page_is_current'] = page_text == expected_page
        result['page_marked_as_test'] = TEST_TEXT in page_text
        result['page_unchanged_from_ui'] = page_text == wa_server.INDEX_HTML
        result['page_version'] = page_version(page_text)
        cap_status, cap = _get(url + 'ui/ultra-chat/capability')
        result['ultra_chat_available'] = json.loads(cap)['ultra_chat']['available']
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
        result['error'] = type(exc).__name__
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
        thread.join(5)
    result['stopped'] = not thread.is_alive()
    target.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    out.write('Самопроверка завершена, сервер остановлен.\n')
    ok = result.get('status') == 200 and result.get('page_is_current') and result['stopped'] and (result.get('page_marked_as_test') == (not launch.standard))
    return 0 if ok else 4

def run_web_alarm(launch: Launch, *, out: TextIO, colors: bool, open_browser: bool=True, self_test: Path | None=None, port: int | None=None, sleep: Callable[[float], None]=time.sleep, opener: Callable[[str], Any]=webbrowser.open) -> int:
    storage_root = None if launch.standard else Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f'wa-test-launch-{launch.name}-'))
    storage_text = str(default_storage_root() if launch.standard else storage_root)
    bind_port = launch.port if port is None else port
    expected_page = mark_page(wa_server.INDEX_HTML, launch)
    claim = _claim_port(bind_port) if bind_port else None
    try:
        if bind_port and (claim is None or _port_in_use(bind_port)):
            raise OSError('port busy')
        server = create_server(WebAlarmApi(storage_root), host=HOST, port=bind_port, enable_folder_picker=launch.folder_picker, enable_ultra_chat=launch.ultra_chat)
    except OSError:
        if claim is not None:
            claim.release()
        _remove_temp_storage(storage_root)
        url = f'http://{HOST}:{bind_port}/'
        out.write(banner(launch, url, storage_text, colors))
        reuse_storage = default_storage_root() if launch.standard else None
        if self_test is None and _already_running(url, expected_page, reuse_storage) == 'same':
            out.write('Этот запуск уже работает (та же версия интерфейса и то же хранилище). Открываю браузер.\n')
            if open_browser:
                opener(url)
            return 0
        out.write('\n' + paint(f'Порт {bind_port} занят другой программой, другой версией или другим режимом Web Alarm. Закройте прежнее окно Web Alarm и запустите снова.', 41, colors) + '\n')
        return 3
    server.RequestHandlerClass = _MarkedHandler
    server.web_alarm_launch = launch
    url = f'http://{HOST}:{server.server_port}/'
    set_console_title('Web Alarm Ultra — ' + STANDARD_TEXT if launch.standard else f'[ТЕСТ] {launch.name} — ' + TEST_TEXT)
    out.write(banner(launch, url, storage_text, colors))
    out.write(f'Версия интерфейса: {page_version(expected_page)}\n')
    out.flush()
    if self_test is not None:
        try:
            return _self_test(server, launch, url, expected_page, storage_text, self_test, out, colors)
        finally:
            if claim is not None:
                claim.release()
            _remove_temp_storage(storage_root)
    _stop_on_break()
    try:
        if not launch.standard:
            for left in range(TEST_WARNING_SECONDS, 0, -1):
                out.write(f'Браузер откроется через {left} с — проверьте, что тестовый режим вам нужен.\n')
                out.flush()
                sleep(1)
        if open_browser:
            opener(url)
        out.write('Сервер работает.\n')
        out.flush()
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()
        if claim is not None:
            claim.release()
        _remove_temp_storage(storage_root)
        out.write('Сервер остановлен.\n')
        out.flush()
    return 0
STANDARD_PORT = 8765

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Launch:
    name: str
    title: str
    standard: bool
    kind: str = 'web_alarm'
    storage: str = 'default'
    port: int = STANDARD_PORT
    folder_picker: bool = True
    ultra_chat: bool = True
    script: str | None = None
    args: tuple[str, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)

def standard_launch() -> Launch:
    return Launch(name=STANDARD, title='Web Alarm Ultra', standard=True, port=standard_port())

def __init__(self, storage_root: str | os.PathLike[str], connections: UltraConnections, *, tk_state_path: Path | None, checker: ApiChecker | None=None, environ: Mapping[str, str] | None=None, now: Callable[[], datetime]=_utc_now, lock_timeout: float=DEFAULT_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) -> None:
    root = Path(storage_root)
    self.settings_path = root / 'ultra' / 'model_settings.json'
    self.checks_path = root / 'ultra' / 'api_checks.json'
    self.view_path = root / 'ultra' / 'evm_view.json'
    self.lock_path = root / 'locks' / 'ultra' / 'model_cards.lock'
    self.connections = connections
    self.tk_state_path = tk_state_path
    self.checker: ApiChecker = checker or LiveCheckNotAuthorized()
    self.environ = os.environ if environ is None else environ
    self.now = now
    self.lock_timeout = lock_timeout

def __init__(self, *, context, context_ref, limits, response, refuse=False):
    if type(limits) is not chat.RequestLimits or limits.max_request_bytes > 8192 or limits.max_response_bytes > 8192 or (limits.max_messages > 32) or (limits.max_message_bytes > 2048) or (limits.timeout_seconds > 10) or (type(refuse) is not bool):
        raise ValueError('Expected bounded offline fixture limits')
    self._context = deepcopy(context)
    self._context_ref = context_ref
    self._limits = limits
    self._transport = _FixtureTransport(deepcopy(response))
    self._refuse = refuse
